meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: Claude 会在临时工作区调试 LazyCodex 或 Codex 系列的缺陷：复现 bug、写回归测试、实施最小修复并验证，然后按目标仓库交付——对 lazycodex 仓库发带补丁的 issue，对 openai/codex 发 fork PR，全程附证据并清理临时文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 bug、贡献修复或开 bug PR，以及调试/提交 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 修复 LazyCodex 的这个 bug，并提交修复。
say.note: 会复现并验证，然后创建带补丁的 issue。

say.text: 为 openai/codex 的这个缺陷创建 fork PR。
say.note: 会先复现并测试，再推分支并创建 PR。

say.text: 调试 omo-codex 的这个问题，给出最小修复。
say.note: 走完整流程，附上验证日志和清理临时文件。

howto.what_en: Claude debuggs LazyCodex or Codex defects in a fresh temp workspace: reproduces the bug, writes a regression test, implements the smallest fix, verifies it, then delivers either a patch-embedded issue to code-yeongyu/lazycodex or a fork PR to openai/codex, cleaning up temp files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug and submit the fix.
say_en.note: Creates a patch-embedded issue after reproduction and verification.

say_en.text: Create a fork PR for this openai/codex defect.
say_en.note: Clones, reproduces, tests, then pushes the branch and opens the PR.

say_en.text: Debug this omo-codex issue and provide a minimal fix.
say_en.note: Runs the full workflow with verification logs and cleanup.
